name_cn: 可复性牙髓炎 (牙髓充血)
synonyms_cn: 可复性牙髓炎|牙髓充血|初期牙髓炎
clinical_summary_en: Inflammation of the pulp that resolves once the noxious stimulus is removed. Brief provoked pain (cold/sweet), no spontaneous or nocturnal pain, no periapical changes.
clinical_summary_cn: 去除刺激源后可恢复的牙髓炎症。冷/甜激发短暂痛，无自发痛或夜间痛，根尖正常。

synonyms_cn: 不可复性牙髓炎|急性不可复性牙髓炎|急性牙髓炎
clinical_summary_en: Inflammation of the pulp that will not resolve. Spontaneous pain, nocturnal worsening, lingering response to cold (>30s), often referred pain. Pulp will progress to necrosis if untreated.
clinical_summary_cn: 无法恢复的牙髓炎症。自发痛、夜间加重、冷刺激后疼痛>30秒，常有牵涉痛。未治疗将进展为牙髓坏死。

name_cn: 化脓性牙髓炎 (牙髓脓肿)
synonyms_cn: 牙髓脓肿|化脓性牙髓炎
clinical_summary_en: Late-stage irreversible pulpitis with frank pus in the pulp chamber. Severe spontaneous pain, often relieved transiently by cold (a distinguishing feature). Marked tenderness to percussion.
clinical_summary_cn: 晚期不可复性牙髓炎伴髓腔脓液。剧烈自发痛，冷刺激可短暂缓解（特征性表现）。叩痛明显。

name_cn: 慢性牙髓炎 (增生性/牙髓息肉)
synonyms_cn: 慢性牙髓炎|增生性牙髓炎|牙髓息肉
clinical_summary_en: Long-standing pulpal inflammation, often asymptomatic or with dull intermittent pain. May present as a pulp polyp through a large carious exposure in young patients.
clinical_summary_cn: 长期牙髓炎症，常无症状或仅有钝痛。年轻患者可经大面积龋暴露形成牙髓息肉。

synonyms_cn: 牙髓坏死|无活力牙髓|死髓
clinical_summary_en: Death of pulp tissue. No response to vitality testing. May be asymptomatic until periapical involvement develops. Tooth discolouration possible.
clinical_summary_cn: 牙髓组织死亡。活力测试无反应。可无症状直至累及根尖。可有牙体变色。

name_en: Acute apical periodontitis of pulpal origin
name_cn: 急性根尖周炎 (牙髓源性)
synonyms_cn: 急性根尖周炎|急性根尖周膜炎
clinical_summary_en: Acute inflammation of the periodontal ligament at the apex due to pulpal disease (extending pulpitis or necrosis). Severe pain on percussion and biting, tooth feels 'high', often with normal X-ray initially.
clinical_summary_cn: 根尖牙周膜的急性炎症，由牙髓疾病引起（牙髓炎扩展或坏死）。叩痛和咬合痛剧烈，患牙浮起感，X线初期可正常。

name_cn: 慢性根尖周炎 (根尖肉芽肿)
synonyms_cn: 慢性根尖周炎|根尖肉芽肿|根尖周肉芽肿
clinical_summary_en: Long-standing low-grade inflammation at the root apex, usually asymptomatic. Periapical radiolucency on X-ray. Tooth typically non-vital. May flare up to acute apical abscess.
clinical_summary_cn: 根尖部位长期低度炎症，通常无症状。X线可见根尖透射影。患牙通常无活力。可急性发作为根尖脓肿。

synonyms_en: chronic apical abscess|draining periapical abscess|fistulating apical abscess
synonyms_cn: 慢性根尖脓肿|瘘管性根尖脓肿|根尖周脓肿伴瘘管
clinical_summary_en: Chronic periapical abscess that has drained through a sinus tract (often visible as a gum boil / parulis). Usually asymptomatic because of ongoing drainage.
clinical_summary_cn: 慢性根尖脓肿经窦道引流（牙龈瘘管/牙龈疖）。因持续引流，通常无症状。

name_en: Periapical abscess without sinus (acute apical abscess)
name_cn: 根尖周脓肿无窦道 (急性根尖脓肿)
synonyms_en: acute apical abscess|acute periapical abscess|dentoalveolar abscess
synonyms_cn: 急性根尖脓肿|急性根尖周脓肿|牙槽脓肿
clinical_summary_en: Acute purulent infection at the root apex without drainage. Severe pain, swelling, often systemic signs (fever, malaise, lymphadenopathy). Surgical emergency.
clinical_summary_cn: 根尖部位无引流的急性化脓性感染。剧烈疼痛、肿胀，常伴全身症状（发热、不适、淋巴结肿大）。外科急症。

name_en: Caries limited to enamel (incipient / white-spot lesion)
name_cn: 釉质龋 (早期龋 / 白斑病变)
synonyms_cn: 早期龋|釉质龋|白斑病变|初期龋
clinical_summary_en: Demineralisation confined to enamel. Visible as white-spot, no cavitation, asymptomatic. Reversible with remineralisation therapy if active disease is controlled.
clinical_summary_cn: 局限于釉质的脱矿。可见白斑，无龋洞，无症状。控制活动性龋病后通过再矿化治疗可逆。

synonyms_cn: 牙本质龋|深龋|龋洞
clinical_summary_en: Carious lesion extending into dentine. May be asymptomatic or cause brief provoked pain to cold/sweet. Treatment varies by depth (mid-dentine vs near-pulp) and by tooth type (primary vs permanent). Lingering pain or spontaneous pain indicates pulpal involvement (re-diagnose as K04.x).
clinical_summary_cn: 龋损延伸至牙本质。可无症状或对冷/甜短暂激发痛。治疗根据深度（中度龋vs近髓）和牙型（乳牙vs恒牙）选择。持续痛或自发痛提示牙髓受累（应重新诊断为K04.x）。

synonyms_cn: 静止龋|稳定龋|无活力龋
clinical_summary_en: Caries that has stopped progressing — typically hard, dark/brown, shiny dentine. No active demineralisation. Conservative management; restore only if functional/aesthetic/cleansability concern.
clinical_summary_cn: 停止进展的龋——硬质、深褐色、光泽牙本质。无活动性脱矿。保守处理；仅在功能/美观/清洁问题时修复。

name_en: Caries on pit and fissure surface, limited to enamel
synonyms_en: pit and fissure caries enamel|occlusal enamel caries
synonyms_cn: 窝沟釉质龋|𬌗面釉质龋
clinical_summary_en: Enamel-limited caries in pit/fissure morphology (occlusal surfaces of molars/premolars). High preventive priority — fissure sealants are evidence-based first-line.
clinical_summary_cn: 窝沟形态（磨牙/前磨牙𬌗面）的釉质局限龋。预防优先级高——窝沟封闭为循证一线治疗。

synonyms_cn: 菌斑性龈炎|慢性龈炎|边缘性龈炎
clinical_summary_en: Inflammation of the gingiva caused by dental plaque. Bleeding on probing, oedema, erythema, no bone loss, probing depth ≤3mm (or pseudo-pocket 4–5mm from oedema without attachment loss). Fully reversible with effective plaque control.
clinical_summary_cn: 牙菌斑所致牙龈炎症。探诊出血、水肿、红肿，无骨丧失，PPD≤3mm（或4–5mm假性牙周袋，但无附着丧失）。通过有效菌斑控制可完全逆转。

synonyms_cn: 非菌斑性龈炎|药物性牙龈增生|病毒性龈炎
clinical_summary_en: Gingival inflammation from non-plaque causes: viral (HSV, HPV), fungal (candida), allergic, drug-induced overgrowth (calcium channel blockers, phenytoin, cyclosporin), or systemic disease. Specialist evaluation is recommended — do not treat as routine plaque-induced gingivitis.
clinical_summary_cn: 非菌斑性病因所致龈炎：病毒（HSV、HPV）、真菌（念珠菌）、过敏、药物性增生（钙通道阻滞剂、苯妥英、环孢素）或全身疾病。建议专科评估——不可按常规菌斑性龈炎处理。

synonyms_en: periodontal abscess|acute periodontal abscess|lateral periodontal abscess
synonyms_cn: 牙周脓肿|急性牙周脓肿|侧支牙周脓肿
clinical_summary_en: Localised purulent infection in the periodontal pocket, distinct from periapical abscess (vital pulp, lateral location). Pain, swelling, deep PPD on probing, often pus on pressure. Drainage is primary treatment; antibiotics only with systemic signs.
clinical_summary_cn: 牙周袋内局限性化脓感染，区别于根尖脓肿（牙髓活力正常、位于侧方）。疼痛、肿胀、探诊深袋、压之有脓。引流为主要治疗；仅在全身症状存在时使用抗生素。

synonyms_cn: 局限性牙周炎|局限性慢性牙周炎
clinical_summary_en: Chronic destructive disease of periodontal tissues affecting <30% of teeth. Bone loss, attachment loss, increased PPD, may have furcation involvement, mobility. Severity (Tonetti Stage I–IV) is captured via clinical answers and drives treatment selection. Same ICD code regardless of stage; stage gates which treatments fire.
clinical_summary_cn: 牙周组织慢性破坏性疾病，影响<30%牙位。骨丧失、附着丧失、PPD增加，可有根分叉受累、松动。严重程度（Tonetti I–IV期）通过临床应答记录并驱动治疗选择。无论分期使用同一ICD编码；分期决定治疗触发。

synonyms_cn: 广泛性牙周炎|广泛性慢性牙周炎
clinical_summary_en: Chronic destructive periodontal disease affecting ≥30% of teeth. Same treatment logic as K05.30 but with implications for systemic management (stronger association with smoking, diabetes, cardiovascular disease). Severity captured via PPD, bone loss, furcation, mobility answers.
clinical_summary_cn: 影响≥30%牙位的慢性破坏性牙周疾病。治疗逻辑同K05.30但更需关注全身管理（与吸烟、糖尿病、心血管疾病相关性更强）。严重程度通过PPD、骨丧失、根分叉、松动等应答记录。

synonyms_cn: 牙龈退缩|牙龈萎缩
clinical_summary_en: Apical displacement of gingival margin beyond the cemento-enamel junction. Classified by Cairo (RT1: no interproximal attachment loss; RT2: interproximal AL less than buccal AL; RT3: greater). Treatment choice depends on class, sensitivity, and aesthetic concern.
clinical_summary_cn: 牙龈边缘根方移位超过釉牙骨质界。Cairo分类：RT1（无邻面附着丧失）、RT2（邻面AL小于颊侧AL）、RT3（更大）。治疗选择取决于分类、敏感、美观需求。

name_cn: 牙龈增生 (增大/过度生长)
synonyms_cn: 牙龈增生|牙龈过度生长|药物性牙龈增生
clinical_summary_en: Increased gingival tissue volume. Causes: drug-induced (calcium channel blockers, phenytoin, cyclosporin), inflammatory (plaque-driven), or hereditary. Management focuses on cause: improve plaque control, consult prescriber for drug substitution where feasible, surgical reduction for persistent functional/aesthetic concern.
clinical_summary_cn: 牙龈组织体积增加。病因：药物性（钙通道阻滞剂、苯妥英、环孢素）、炎症性（菌斑驱动）或遗传性。管理重点为病因：改善菌斑控制、与处方医师协商换药、对持续功能/美观问题行外科切除。

name_cn: 复发性口腔溃疡 (复发性阿弗他溃疡)
synonyms_cn: 复发性口腔溃疡|阿弗他溃疡|口疮
clinical_summary_en: Painful, recurrent, well-defined ulcers on non-keratinised mucosa (labial, buccal, ventral tongue, floor of mouth). Round/oval, yellow-grey base, erythematous halo. Heal in 7–14 days WITHOUT scarring (minor RAS). Recurrence is the diagnostic feature.
clinical_summary_cn: 非角化黏膜（唇、颊、舌腹、口底）的复发性疼痛性边界清晰溃疡。圆形或卵圆形，黄灰色基底，红晕。（轻型）7–14天内愈合且不留瘢痕。复发为诊断要素。

name_en: Cellulitis and abscess of mouth (oral cellulitis, fascial space infection)
synonyms_en: oral cellulitis|Ludwig's angina|submandibular space infection|fascial space infection
synonyms_cn: 口腔蜂窝织炎|Ludwig咽峡炎|颌下间隙感染|面颊间隙感染
clinical_summary_en: Diffuse soft-tissue infection of the mouth and adjacent fascial spaces. Source typically odontogenic (K04.7 spreading or K05.20 spreading). Rapidly progressive — airway threat. EMERGENCY management.
clinical_summary_cn: 口腔及邻近筋膜间隙的弥漫性软组织感染。多为牙源性扩散（K04.7或K05.20）。进展迅速——气道威胁。急诊处理。

name_cn: 口腔黏膜炎 (化疗/放疗诱发)
synonyms_cn: 化疗诱发性黏膜炎|放疗黏膜炎|肿瘤治疗相关黏膜炎
clinical_summary_en: Inflammation and ulceration of oral mucosa caused by cytotoxic chemotherapy or head/neck radiotherapy. Onset typically 5–10 days after chemo start; can be severe (WHO grade 3–4) and limit oral intake. Management is supportive — no curative treatment exists.
clinical_summary_cn: 细胞毒化疗或头颈部放疗所致口腔黏膜炎症与溃疡。化疗开始后5–10天发作；可严重（WHO 3–4级）影响进食。治疗为支持性——目前无根治方法。

name_cn: 唇炎（口角炎、剥脱性、接触性）
synonyms_cn: 口角炎|脱屑性唇炎|接触性唇炎
clinical_summary_en: Inflammation of the lips. Angular variant: fissuring at commissures, often candidal, frequently associated with reduced occlusal vertical dimension, ill-fitting dentures, iron/B12/folate deficiency. Treat the cause, not just the symptoms.
clinical_summary_cn: 唇部炎症。口角炎型：口角皲裂，常合并念珠菌感染，多由垂直距离降低、义齿不合、铁/B12/叶酸缺乏所致。治本，不只对症。

name_en: Leukoplakia of oral mucosa (oral potentially malignant disorder)
name_cn: 口腔白斑 (口腔潜在恶性病变)
synonyms_cn: 白斑|口腔白斑|潜在恶性病变
clinical_summary_en: A clinically defined white patch or plaque that cannot be characterised as any other definable lesion (WHO 2017). Cannot be diagnosed clinically alone — BIOPSY is mandatory to determine dysplasia grade. Annual malignant transformation rate 1–3%; higher in non-homogeneous and high-risk sites (lateral tongue, floor of mouth).
clinical_summary_cn: 临床上不能归入任何其他明确病变的白色斑块（WHO 2017）。不可仅凭临床诊断——必须活检确定上皮异型增生分级。年恶变率1–3%；非均质型与高危部位（舌侧缘、口底）更高。

synonyms_cn: 口腔黏膜下纤维化|OSMF
clinical_summary_en: Chronic, progressive, scarring disease of the oral mucosa. Strongly associated with areca/betel-nut chewing (Asia, Pacific). Burning sensation, blanched mucosa, fibrous bands, restricted mouth opening (trismus). Malignant transformation rate 7–13%. Cessation of areca is essential.
clinical_summary_cn: 口腔黏膜的慢性进行性瘢痕性疾病。与咀嚼槟榔/槟榔块密切相关（亚洲、太平洋地区）。灼烧感、黏膜苍白、纤维条索、张口受限。恶变率7–13%。停用槟榔为根本措施。
confirmation_findings: areca_betel_use in [current, past]|mouth_opening_mm<=35 OR blanched_mucosa=yes OR fibrous_bands=yes

name_en: Erythroplakia (red patch — high-risk oral potentially malignant disorder)
name_cn: 红斑 (口腔红斑——高危潜在恶性病变)
synonyms_cn: 红斑|口腔红斑|高危潜在恶性病变
clinical_summary_en: A clinically defined red patch that cannot be characterised as any other definable lesion. URGENT biopsy referral — 40–50% show carcinoma in situ or invasive carcinoma AT FIRST BIOPSY. Highest malignant potential of any OPMD.
clinical_summary_cn: 临床上不能归入任何其他明确病变的红色斑块。紧急活检转诊——首次活检即有40–50%为原位癌或浸润癌。所有OPMD中恶变潜能最高。

synonyms_cn: 口腔扁平苔藓|Wickham纹
clinical_summary_en: Chronic immune-mediated mucocutaneous disease. Reticular (lacy Wickham's striae, asymptomatic), erosive (painful ulcers), or atrophic forms. Malignant transformation 1–2% — erosive/atrophic forms warrant closer surveillance. Biopsy to confirm; manage with topical corticosteroids.
clinical_summary_cn: 免疫介导的慢性黏膜皮肤病。网状型（蕾丝状Wickham纹，无症状）、糜烂型（疼痛溃疡）或萎缩型。恶变率1–2%——糜烂/萎缩型需密切随访。活检确诊；局部皮质类固醇治疗。

name_cn: 根面龋 (牙根暴露的牙骨质/牙本质)
synonyms_cn: 根面龋|颈部龋|牙骨质龋
clinical_summary_en: Caries on the exposed root surface, typically due to gingival recession + xerostomia + biofilm. Common in elderly. Treatment selection considers access, isolation, and proximity to pulp/PDL.
clinical_summary_cn: 牙根暴露面的龋损，常因牙龈退缩+口干+菌斑所致。老年人多见。治疗考虑可视、隔湿、距牙髓/牙周膜距离。
